notes: Accepted teens serve at least one year. Meetings are virtual.
name: Teen Leadership Council
what_you_do: Help plan library events. Share ideas to make the library better for teens. Build leadership skills.
who_can_apply: Teens in grades 7 to 12 who live or go to school in St. Louis City.
deadline_text: No deadline listed. Meets online on the third Thursday of each month, 6 to 7 p.m.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application form linked on the council page.
